notes: The %studyFlags macro (a 4-way PROC FREQ cross-tab, including the name-literal column 'Current Status'n exactly as the author wrote it) is unmodified. %ReadTheXL and %MergeWFS2XL, which read a local XLSX pull-list tracker and join to a live Postgres item-workflow database via %SetIMRTPrd (a toolbox.sas macro embedding a live database password, not reproduced anywhere in this bundle), are not called. libhere.sumELA_w_WFS is instead built inline from small mock rows (no PII) carrying the same four columns (AsmtType, Role, 'Current Status'n, workflow_status) that studyFlags cross-tabulates.
